departing_trials.source_excerpt: Moll 2006 (BMJ, NCT-registered multicentre RCT), abstract: '111 women were allocated to clomifene citrate plus metformin (metformin group) and 114 women were allocated to clomifene citrate plus placebo (placebo group). The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 64% compared with 72% in the placebo group.' Counts recovered as the unique integers consistent with the reported rate and denominator: round(0.64*111)=71 (71/111=63.96% -> '64%'; 70->63%, 72->65%), round(0.72*114)=82 (82/114=71.9% -> '72%'; 81->71%, 83->73%). Metformin ARM WORSE than placebo (an S2 add-on-to-clomifene contrast; treatment-naive PCOS).
departing_trials.effect_calculation: (ai/(n1i-ai))/(ci/(n2i-ci)); add 0.5 to all cells if any zero

departing_trials.source_excerpt: Ben Ayed 2009, abstract: '32 PCOS women were recruited in the study and equally allocated to the two groups. The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 62.5% compared with 37.5% in the placebo group.' Equal allocation of 32 -> 16 per arm; counts are exact: 62.5% of 16 = 10, 37.5% of 16 = 6 (an S2 add-on-to-clomifene contrast, metformin+CC vs CC+placebo).

direction_policy: Estimate-absence transitions take precedence: numeric to absent RESULT_REMOVED; absent to numeric RESULT_ADDED; both absent NO_DIRECTION even if candidate k changes. For two numerical results, AWAY_FROM_NULL takes priority if any of larger absolute effect (absolute log ratio or absolute MD), narrower comparable CI, more favourable point, or newly favourable CI applies. Mixed signals are disclosed. A newly favourable CI with no prior CI is a new claim, never a computed narrowing. Otherwise weakening is TOWARD_NULL; unchanged point with membership change is MEMBERSHIP_ONLY. All outcomes here favour lower values except ovulation, which favours higher odds; harm disappearance is flagged for presentation favourability, never treated as evidence of safety.
